info.name: Retrieves a list of all sale items.

params.name: a_direct_link
params.description:
Arguments from direct purchase link, which can give additional access to products, which are available
  only by such link.

params.name: is_credit_card_check
params.description:
`true` to consider the requirement to have a credit card for booking
(this requirement can be set in business settings)
`false` to ignore it.

params.name: k_business
params.description: The business key.

params.name: k_location
params.description: The key of a location. If `0`, all products in the business are retrieved.

params.name: uid
params.description: The key of user.

items.docs:
Used to render the full client-facing store catalog for a business. Returns all purchasable items -
promotions, products, events, and coupons - merged across the business's categories. The separate
de-duplicated list and category list support both the flat and category-tabbed views.

params.name: a_item
params.description: The list of items in the cart.

params.name: is_auto_apply_prize
params.description: Whether selected login prize should be auto applied to first applicable item.

params.name: k_location
params.description: The location key.

params.name: k_login_prize
params.description: The login prize key.

params.name: text_discount_code
params.description:
The discount code.

If `null`, the discount code has been reset.

params.name: uid
params.description:
The user key.

This will be `0` for guests.

items.docs:
Used in the client-facing checkout flow to show a live price summary before the client submits
payment. Calculates the full breakdown - subtotal, taxes, applied discounts, reward redemptions,
and tips - so the client can review the total before confirming.

info.name: Allows to pay items for the client.

params.name: a_commission
params.description: The staff commission earned for this purchase. If this isn't empty, it has the next fields:

params.name: id_mode
params.description: The WellnessLiving mode type (required). One of the [ModeSid](#/components/schemas/Wl.Mode.ModeSid) constants.

params.name: is_guest
params.description: Determines if the payment owner is an anonymous user (optional).

params.name: is_staff
params.description: Specify this if operations are performed by the staff member (optional).

params.name: k_business
params.description: The business key (required).

params.name: k_location
params.description: The location key (required).

params.name: uid
params.description: The user's key (required).

items.docs:
The checkout endpoint that finalizes a purchase in the client-facing store. Charges the client's
selected payment method, applies any discounts and tips, and creates the purchase record. Returns
the resulting purchase key so the frontend can redirect to the confirmation page.

Returns full receipt data for the specified purchase, including business details, customer information,
itemized purchase items, payment methods, pricing summary, and print URLs.
